title: ElementCheck：基于句子元素的复杂度感知长文本事实性评估
summary: 针对现有长文本事实性评估中分解噪声和固定验证粒度的问题，提出ElementCheck框架。通过提取句子中可验证的实体对作为元素并构建元素图，利用图拓扑估计句子复杂度，对简单句子直接验证，复杂句子进行元素级细化验证。新基准FastFact-Sent支持细粒度评估，实验表明在五个骨干模型上提升事实性验证效果，并保持良好准确率-成本权衡。
summary_en: ElementCheck is a complexity-aware framework for long-form factuality evaluation. It extracts entity pairs as elements and builds an element graph to estimate sentence complexity, enabling direct verification for simple sentences and targeted refinement for complex ones. A new benchmark FastFact-Sent is introduced. Experiments show consistent improvements across five backbones with favorable accuracy-cost trade-off.
